patient_persona.description: Puan Nadiah binti Azhar, 26, female, mother of a 4-day-old boy, first baby born at 38 weeks; admin assistant from Klang. Tired, worried, still sore after delivery.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Premala a/p Sivalingam, Malaysian Indian woman in her 30s, medical officer at a Klang klinik kesihatan maternal and child health unit. Gentle, efficient; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, jururawat yang datang rumah semalam kata baby saya kuning. Sekarang saya tengok mata dia pun kuning, sampai perut.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: OK, terima kasih bawa dia cepat. Baby lahir hari apa, pukul berapa?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hari Isnin, pukul sepuluh pagi. Normal delivery, berat 2.9 kilo.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dia menyusu macam mana? Susu badan je, atau campur formula?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Susu badan je, exclusive breastfeeding. Tapi dia banyak tidur, kadang-kadang saya kena kejut untuk susukan. Sehari mungkin enam tujuh kali.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Lampin basah berapa kali sehari? Warna najis dia macam mana?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lampin basah empat lima kali. Najis kuning, macam biji sawi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Warna tu bagus. Kalau najis pucat macam kapur, itu yang kita risau. Saya ambil darah sikit dari tumit untuk check bilirubin ya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Keputusan serum bilirubin 285 micromol per litre. Untuk umur empat hari, dia dah dekat paras untuk phototherapy.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Phototherapy tu apa, doktor? Kena masuk wad ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Rawatan dengan lampu biru, dia pecahkan kuning dalam kulit. Ya, kena masuk wad pediatric hari ni, biasanya satu dua hari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Mak saya suruh jemur dia bawah matahari pagi je, morning sun. Tak cukup ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Matahari tak cukup kuat dan boleh buat kulit baby terbakar. Lampu kat hospital lebih selamat dan berkesan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Masa lahir, nurse ada kata G6PD dia normal. Ada kena mengena tak?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus, G6PD normal. Kuning dia mungkin sebab penyusuan belum lancar. Dalam wad, susukan setiap dua hingga tiga jam, kejut dia kalau perlu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya boleh temankan dia dalam wad?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh, ibu boleh tinggal dan susukan terus. Nurse akan bawa puan ke wad sekarang.

patient_persona.description: Mr. Soh Kian Wee, 31, male, father of a 3-day-old girl; mechanic in Muar, Johor. Worried, direct, grandparents at home holding strong views.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Siti Aminah binti Kassim, Malay woman in her 40s, paediatric medical officer at a Muar hospital. Calm, firm; English with Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我女儿昨天出院的时候，nurse 说她是 G6PD deficiency。今天整个脸黄黄的，我老婆很担心。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Thank you for coming early. G6PD deficient babies boleh jadi kuning lebih cepat dan lebih tinggi, so early check is important.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: G6PD 到底是什么？我阿嬷说是 blood 有问题。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's an enzyme in the red blood cells. Without enough, the cells break down easily, especially with certain triggers. The broken cells make bilirubin, 就是黄疸.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Her serum bilirubin today is 260, at 60 hours old. G6PD 的宝宝我们会比较早开始 phototherapy. So she needs admission today.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 住院？她才三天大……要住多久？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Usually two to three days under the blue light. We check her blood every few hours to make sure the level comes down.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我妈妈在家准备了黄连水，说喝了可以退黄。Can give her or not？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: No, jangan. Traditional herbs like 黄连 can trigger severe red cell breakdown in G6PD babies. Very dangerous.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 啊？那还有什么不可以的？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: No mothballs, 樟脑丸, in the house or clothes cupboard. Avoid some medicines, like aspirin and certain antibiotics. I'll give you a card with the list.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 樟脑丸……我们家衣柜里全都是。I will throw away tonight.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Also, breastmilk is fine. But mum should avoid fava beans, kacang parang, 蚕豆, while breastfeeding.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 她长大以后会一直生病吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Most G6PD children live normally, just avoid the triggers. 以后看任何医生, always tell them she has G6PD.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我明白了。我先打电话给我老婆和我妈。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. The nurse will bring her to the special care nursery. 你和你太太 can visit and breastfeed anytime.

condition: Prolonged neonatal jaundice with pale stools, referral

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Jennifer Ling, 30, female, mother of Ethan, 3 weeks old; church administrator in Sibu, Sarawak. Articulate, a little apologetic, Sarawakian English with some Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ahmad Farid bin Mazlan, Malay man in his 30s, family medicine doctor at a Sibu klinik kesihatan. Serious but kind; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, Ethan still kuning. Three weeks already. My mother says breastfed babies take longer, so I just waited.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sometimes that's true, breastmilk jaundice can last a few weeks. But I need to ask a few things. What colour is his stool?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hmm, recently quite pale. Like light cream colour. I thought maybe sebab makanan saya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Can you compare with this stool colour card? Which one looks most like his?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: This one, number two. Very pale, putih macam kapur.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: And his urine? Is it clear, or dark yellow staining the diaper?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Quite dark, the diaper got yellow stain, kuning pekat. Is that bad?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pale stools and dark urine mean the bile is not flowing from the liver into the gut. We must rule out biliary atresia, a blockage of the bile ducts.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Biliary atresia? Is that serious?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's serious, but treatable with surgery. Masa tu sangat penting. Surgery done before 60 days old gives the best result, so we cannot wait.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh my God. I should have come earlier. Saya rasa bersalah sangat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Don't blame yourself. You came at three weeks, that's still in time. The blood test today will check conjugated bilirubin and liver function.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: What happens next?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'm referring Ethan to the paediatric team at Sibu Hospital today, dan mereka mungkin rujuk cepat ke surgical team in Kuching.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Today? Okay, my husband can drive us. Perlu bawa apa-apa?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bring his pink book, the stool card, and a nappy with fresh stool if possible. Continue breastfeeding.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you, doctor. Saya takut, but at least we know what to do.

patient_persona.description: Puan Hanisah binti Mohd Nor, 37, female, mother of 7-day-old twins, fourth pregnancy; teacher in Kota Bharu. Experienced mother, calm, humorous.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Syed Mohd Arif bin Syed Hussein, Malay man in his 30s, medical officer at a Kota Bharu klinik kesihatan. Friendly; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Assalamualaikum, puan. Kembar dua ni baru keluar wad dua hari lepas, kan? Phototherapy satu hari?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Waalaikumussalam. Ya, doktor. Yang abang satu hari, yang adik dua hari. Hari ni nurse suruh datang check balik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Macam mana penyusuan? Susu badan cukup untuk dua orang?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Cukup, alhamdulillah. Anak-anak dulu pun saya susukan sampai dua tahun. Cuma sekarang penat sikit lah, two babies at the same time.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tahniah, puan memang pakar. Kuning dia pada mata puan, makin kurang atau makin banyak?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Rasa makin kurang. Tapi yang adik ni kulit masih kuning sikit kat muka.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya check bilirubin dua-dua. Abang 150, adik 190. Dua-dua jauh bawah paras phototherapy dan menurun. Good.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Jadi tak perlu masuk wad lagi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak perlu. Tapi kalau kuning makin teruk, sampai tapak tangan dan tapak kaki, atau dia malas menyusu, come back immediately.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Najis dia kuning, kencing pun jernih. Semua OK kan?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Semua tanda baik. Berat pun naik, abang 2.6 kilo, adik 2.4 kilo.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Emak saya nak mandikan dengan air rebusan daun, dia kata buang kuning. Boleh ke? Herbal bath?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mandi air biasa je, puan. Air daun tu tak terbukti, dan kalau daun tertentu boleh bahaya pada kulit baby.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baiklah, saya bagitahu emak. Dia degil sikit tapi saya cuba, I'll try my best.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita jumpa lagi masa dua minggu, sekali untuk timbang dan check kuning. Nurse KK pun akan datang rumah.

condition: Neonatal jaundice in the first 24 hours, ABO incompatibility

patient_persona.description: Mr. Prakash a/l Rajendran, 34, male, father of a 20-hour-old baby girl; secondary school maths teacher in Seremban. Anxious, precise, asks for numbers.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Tan Lay Hoon, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, paediatrician at a Seremban hospital postnatal ward. Clear, direct; English with Malay words.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Prakash, I want to update you about your daughter. Nurse nampak kulit dia kuning this morning, at only 20 hours of life.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, my wife saw it also. Is it normal? My first son also kuning, but at day three.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jaundice in the first 24 hours is never considered normal. We check more carefully. Her serum bilirubin is 180 micromol per litre, which is high for her age.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 180. What is the cutoff? I want to understand.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: At 20 hours, the phototherapy line is lower than at day three. She's above it, so we're starting phototherapy right now.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Why is this happening so early?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your wife's blood group is O positive, and your daughter is A positive. Mum's antibodies can cross the placenta and break down baby's red cells. We call it ABO incompatibility.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So it's my wife's fault? Kesian dia, she will feel very bad.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Nobody's fault, bukan salah sesiapa. It's quite common, and usually mild. The Coombs test is positive, which confirms it. Her haemoglobin is still okay at 15.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Will she need blood transfusion?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Most don't. Intensive phototherapy usually works. Kalau paras naik cepat, we may need an exchange transfusion, but that's uncommon.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: How often will you check?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Every four to six hours at first. Your wife can continue breastfeeding, we'll bring her to the nursery every three hours.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, thank you, doctor. Can I stay with her?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, one parent can stay. Please keep her eyes covered under the light, the nurse will show you. Jangan risau sangat, we'll keep you updated.

condition: Childhood asthma with poor control, inhaler technique

patient_persona.description: Puan Zuraidah binti Kamal, 38, female, mother of Haziq, 7 years old, 22 kg; nurse's aide in Alor Gajah, Melaka. Frazzled, frequent visits, blames the weather.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Leong Wai Kit, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, family medicine specialist at a Melaka klinik kesihatan. Methodical, friendly with kids; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, Haziq ni lelah lagi. Bulan ni dah dua kali pergi emergency kena neb. Cuaca jerebu ni teruk sangat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jerebu memang boleh trigger. Selain tu, malam dia batuk tak? Sampai terjaga?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hampir setiap malam batuk, lebih-lebih lagi pukul tiga empat pagi. Sekolah pun dia selalu penat, no energy.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ubat pencegah, inhaler oren tu, dia guna setiap hari ke?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yang oren tu bila dia sakit je saya bagi. Kalau dah OK, saya stop, takut steroid banyak sangat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ha, itu masalah dia. Inhaler oren, budesonide, ni ubat pencegah. Kena guna setiap hari walaupun dia sihat, pagi dan malam.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tapi steroid tu tak bahaya ke untuk budak? Nanti tak tinggi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dos dalam inhaler sangat kecil, dia terus ke paru-paru. Kesan pada ketinggian sangat sikit. Lelah yang tak terkawal lebih bahaya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Haziq, cuba tunjuk doktor macam mana guna inhaler biru ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dia sedut terus dari mulut, tak pakai spacer. Spacer tu dah pecah bulan lepas.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tanpa spacer, kebanyakan ubat melekat kat tekak je. Saya bagi spacer baru. Goncang inhaler, sambung ke spacer, tekan satu kali, tarik nafas lima kali.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, lima kali tarik nafas. Selama ni saya tak tahu, nobody taught me.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Budesonide 200mcg, dua kali sehari, pagi dan malam, lepas tu kumur mulut. Salbutamol biru tu bila lelah, dua hingga empat puff dengan spacer.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada kucing kat rumah, doktor. Ada kaitan tak?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mungkin. Jangan bagi kucing masuk bilik tidur dia. Saya bagi asthma action plan ni, dan jumpa lagi sebulan.

condition: Acute asthma attack in a preschooler, nebuliser in clinic

patient_persona.description: Ho Siew Yin, 35, female, mother of Jayden, 4 years old, 16 kg; accounts clerk in Klang. Frightened, speaks rapidly, English terms mixed in.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Izzat bin Kamarul, Malay man in his 30s, GP at a Klang 24-hour clinic. Calm under pressure; English with Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，快点看他！他从昨晚开始 wheezing，今天早上喘到讲不到话，一直 cough。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay, I see him. His chest is pulling in, oxygen 91 percent. We start nebuliser now, salbutamol. 妈妈你抱着他。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 家里的 Ventolin 我给了，可是他不肯用 spacer，一直哭。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Very common at this age. After the neb we'll try a mask with the spacer, 小孩子比较容易用.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: How many puffs did you give at home, 几点给的?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 早上六点给了两下，八点再两下，好像 no effect.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For an attack, you can give up to six puffs for his age, 每二十分钟 for the first hour. 两下太少了.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 六下？我以为太多会 overdose。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Salbutamol is quite safe. Side effects are just shaky hands and fast heartbeat. 不用怕.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: After first neb, oxygen 95, 呼吸好一点了. We give second neb, plus prednisolone 16mg, one mg per kilo, orally.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那个 steroid 要吃几天？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Three days, 一天一次，早上饭后吃. If he's okay after one more hour, you can go home.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 他以前医生都说是 bronchitis，没有人说 asthma。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: At this age we sometimes call it preschool wheeze. 他常常发作又有 eczema, asthma is likely. We'll review in one week.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 回家以后要怎么办？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ventolin with mask spacer, four puffs every four hours for two days. If he can't talk, ribs pulling, or lips blue, call 999 or go to emergency terus.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我明白了。谢谢医生，我真的吓死了。

condition: Exercise-induced asthma in an adolescent athlete

patient_persona.description: Muhammad Irfan bin Ruslan, 15, male, school football player in Johor Bahru, attending with his father who stays quiet. Energetic, casual teen Manglish.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Priyanka a/p Mahendran, Malaysian Indian woman in her 30s, sports medicine doctor at a JB private clinic. Upbeat, direct; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hi Irfan. Your father says you get sesak nafas during football. Tell me what happens.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doc, like after ten, fifteen minutes running, my chest rasa ketat, then I start batuk and wheezing. Must stop and rest.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: How long does it take to recover?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: About twenty, thirty minutes. Coach thinks I'm lazy, but really cannot breathe, bukan malas.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any cough or wheeze at night, malam-malam, or when you're not exercising?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No lah, only during training. Especially evening training kat padang, and masa jerebu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any eczema, hay fever, family history of asthma?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My mum got asthma. I had bersin-bersin every morning since small.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your lung function at rest is normal. After the treadmill test, it dropped by 18 percent, then improved after inhaler. That fits exercise-induced bronchoconstriction.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So I can still main bola? Next month got MSSD tournament, confirm tak boleh miss.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Definitely boleh. Many top athletes have it. Use salbutamol, two puffs, fifteen minutes before training. Warm-up sepuluh minit pun membantu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Inhaler before every training? Is it allowed in competition? Nanti kena doping test.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Salbutamol by inhaler at normal doses is permitted. I'll write a letter with the diagnosis, just in case.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, nice. What if I still rasa dada ketat during the game?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Stop, take two more puffs. If it's used more than twice a week, or you get night symptoms, come back. You may need a daily preventer.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Got it. Can Dad keep the inhaler also, simpan dalam kereta?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good idea. Carry one in your kit bag, one at home. And bring the spacer to school if you can.

patient_persona.description: Puan Azlina binti Ramli, 32, female, mother of Aisyah, 5 years old, 18 kg; online kuih seller in Kuantan. Chatty, organised, keeps a symptom diary.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chew Mei Chin, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, paediatrician at a Kuantan hospital clinic. Warm, methodical; Malay with English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Assalamualaikum, puan. Aisyah, cantiknya tudung. Macam mana asma dia tiga bulan ni?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Waalaikumussalam, doktor. Better sikit sejak guna inhaler oren setiap hari. Tapi bila selsema, mesti lelah. Saya ada catat dalam buku ni.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus, puan catat. Saya tengok, bulan lepas tiga kali guna Ventolin sebab selsema. Ada admission?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada. Tapi satu kali pergi klinik untuk neb. Malam pun batuk-batuk bila selsema.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Teknik inhaler dengan spacer, boleh tunjuk?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Aisyah, tunjuk kat doktor. Goncang dulu, pasang spacer, pakai mask, tekan, kira sampai sepuluh.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pandai! Teknik betul, very good technique. Jadi ubat dia dah betul, tapi masih ada attack bila selsema. Kita boleh tambah ubat lain.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat apa, doktor? Steroid lagi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bukan steroid. Montelukast 4mg, satu sachet granule, makan setiap malam. Dia kurangkan radang dalam saluran nafas.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada side effect tak? Saya dengar ada budak jadi mimpi ngeri, nightmares.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Betul, jarang-jarang ada budak mimpi buruk atau perubahan mood. Kalau nampak macam tu, stop dan beritahu kami.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK. Budesonide tu teruskan dos sama?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Teruskan 200mcg dua kali sehari. Kalau tiga bulan ni stable, we can try to step down.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, saya ada bela kucing, tapi dah keluarkan dari rumah. Anything else I can do?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cuci cadar dengan air panas seminggu sekali, dan elak asap rokok. Pastikan vaccine influenza tahunan pun diambil.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik doktor. Terima kasih banyak.

condition: Asthma action plan for a school-age child with frequent school absence

patient_persona.description: Mr. Tee Chun Wai, 44, male, father of Jia Hao, 10 years old, 30 kg; durian seller in Raub, Pahang. Blunt, sceptical of long-term medicine, speaks Mandarin with Hakka rhythm.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kavita a/p Ramasamy, Malaysian Indian woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist at a Raub klinik kesihatan. Patient, persuasive; English with Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Tee, school sent a letter. Jia Hao missed twelve days this term because of asthma. 很多.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 对，每次喘就要请假。可是那个每天的 inhaler 我没有给，我觉得小孩子不要每天吃药。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I understand your worry. But asthma is inflammation in the airways every day, even when he looks fine. 气管一直在发炎.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 可是他没有喘的时候，看起来好好的，还跟朋友踢 football。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's good. But the attacks come because the inflammation is not controlled. 预防的药 fluticasone, reduces attacks by a lot.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 里面有 steroid，我怕他以后长不高。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Inhaled steroid is a very small dose, 分量很少. Studies show only about one centimetre difference at most. 常常请假 is a bigger problem.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一公分……好啦，那还可以接受。要怎样用？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Fluticasone 125mcg, 早上两下，晚上两下, with spacer. Rinse mouth after.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll give you this asthma action plan. Green zone, 没有症状, use preventer only. Yellow zone, cough or wheeze, add Ventolin four puffs every four hours.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 红色的呢？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Red zone, very breathless, cannot talk, Ventolin not helping. Give ten puffs and go to hospital immediately. 不要等.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 这张纸我贴在冰箱上。School also need one copy?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, give one copy to his class teacher. 书包里也要放 Ventolin and spacer.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好。果园那边榴莲季节很多灰尘，也有关系吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dust can trigger. 喷农药的时候, keep him away. Come back in one month, we'll see how many days he misses.
